name: Ashihara no Anima
storyline:
In the forbidden lands, Orochi was slain.

It was something that had happened time and again in this world — or so it was supposed to be.

When the hunter Homura struck off its head, the corpse did not vanish.

Instead, a girl appeared. She was alive — but remembered nothing, not even her name.

Abandoning her would have ended it all.

But Homura chose otherwise.

To restore the girl’s lost memories, she chooses to enter her dreams — to walk through a world shaped by memory and search for the source of the nightmare.

Yet once inside, Homura faces a single dilemma: to end the nightmare — or to let it remain.

The scenes witnessed in the dream quietly begin to overlap with reality.
summary: This is a narrative-driven adventure game in which you dive into another’s nightmare and intervene in the source of the anomaly. As Homura, a hunter, you explore the dreams of a girl who has lost her memory, and experience a story where nightmares and reality begin to overlap.
